summary: CreatorOS iteration 3 verified end-to-end. All 16 iteration-3 pytest cases pass in 52.95s (handoff status/brief/slack-unconfigured, scripts CRUD + refine with real Claude output, calendar CRUD, /api/me/* auth-gated 401s). All frontend flows in the review request pass — handoff modal (Copy verified via clipboard read=996 chars markdown, Email verified via CDP Page.frameRequestedNavigation capturing mailto: URL with subject+body, Slack setup modal shows 5 steps), Idea Lab → Turn into script navigates and creates a real 5950-char Claude draft, editor Save + AI Refine both persist (refine grew body from 5950 → 6422 chars with new content), Studio tabbed with Assistant (default) + Weekly plan, HTML5 DnD adds plan-items and remove works, Shortlist saved-send-* button opens the HandoffMenu modal, nav shows all 7 items (Feed/Trends/DNA/Studio/Scripts/Saved/Collab). Iteration 1+2 regression tests still pass.
ai_features_verdicts: primary: POST /api/scripts (Claude script drafting) — pass — evidence: HTTP 200, body length=5950 chars for opp-1 draft, contains anchors ['hook','beat','b-roll','on camera']. Direct API call takes ~14s. Skill: ai-testing-llm

POST /api/scripts/{id}/refine (Claude script refinement) — pass — evidence: before_body_len=428 (seed), after_len=~2000+, different content, persists in DB (subsequent GET returns new body). UI flow: refine grew body from 5950 → 6422 chars with EDIT MARKER preserved by LLM reorg. Skill: ai-testing-llm

POST /api/handoff/slack (unconfigured branch) — pass (unconfigured-by-design) — evidence: 400 'Slack webhook not configured — see /api/handoff/status for setup steps' when SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL is unset. Setup guide payload from /api/handoff/status returns 5 numbered steps. Skill: n/a (integration test)

GET /api/me/creator (real DNA path) — blocked: needs-google-oauth-credentials — evidence: unauth returns 401 as spec requires (NOT 404, no route collision). Authenticated path not testable because GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is intentionally unset for this iteration. The DNADashboard fallback to seeded Alex is verified working.

GET /api/handoff/brief/opp-1 — pass — evidence: 200 OK, markdown 996 chars, contains '# I Replaced My First Employee', 'Score:', '## Why this fits, right now', '## Score breakdown'. Subject='[Brief] I Replaced My First Employee With an AI Agent — 30 Day Log'. Skill: n/a

issues: Dialog fires accessibility warnings: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'. Non-blocking but visible in console — add DialogDescription for a11y.

action_items: Spec inconsistency (NOT a code bug): review_request states 'source list of 6 opportunities' in Weekly Plan, but seed_data.py only has 5 alex-morgan opportunities (opp-1..opp-5). WeeklyPlan.jsx correctly renders `opps.slice(0,6)` so it shows all 5. Either add a 6th seeded opp or update the spec — not a functional bug.
Optional a11y: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to HandoffMenu / SlackSetup dialogs to silence radix-ui a11y warnings visible in console.
critical_code_review_comments: features.py:307 `_derive_dna_from_channel` uses `user['id']` — assumes cached auth doc always has 'id'; if `current_user` returns a dict without 'id' key, this KeyErrors instead of returning None. Guard with .get.

features.py:225 refine prompt concatenates full existing body every turn (`Existing script:\n{s['body']}`). For scripts that grow large (5950+ chars) plus new body 6000+, token cost per refine call is significant. Consider truncating or summarizing when body exceeds ~4000 tokens.
features.py:190 PATCH /scripts/{script_id}: `req.body is not None` allows empty-string body to overwrite good content. Consider validating min length or requiring non-empty when 'body' is provided.

DNADashboard.jsx:30 `cardUrl` always uses DEMO_CREATOR_ID even when isReal=true (see inline TODO). Sharing DNA card for a real user actually shares Alex's card — misleading UX. Not in-scope for this iteration but should be tracked.
features.py: Slack POST error branch (HTTPException 502) exposes upstream response body via `r.text[:200]` — fine for demo but sanitize for prod (Slack webhook errors sometimes echo signed URLs).

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 iteration-3 pytest, 8/8 iteration-2 pytest passing on prior run, 14/14 iteration-1)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (handoff copy/email/slack-setup, scripts create/save/refine, weekly-plan DnD add + remove, shortlist send, nav 7-items)

test_credentials: None. Google OAuth intentionally unconfigured this iteration — /me/* endpoints only tested for 401 fallback. Slack webhook intentionally unconfigured — only fallback tested.
seed_data_creation: Test-only: pytest fixtures create per-run X-Client-Id namespaces (TEST_iter3a_* for scripts, TEST_iter3b_* for calendar). Playwright flow bookmarked opp-1 into the browser's client-id namespace and left it saved (harmless). Idea-lab cache for opp-1 was warmed by test_create_script_returns_real_claude_body.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://opportunity-feed-6.preview.emergentagent.com. pytest.ini uses -n 2 --dist loadscope; export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env before running. Iteration-3 tests take ~53s due to real Claude latency on script create + refine (~14s each). Alex seed has only 5 opportunities (spec incorrectly said 6 for Weekly Plan sources). HTML5 DnD in headless Chromium requires event-dispatch with small delays between dragstart→dragover→drop to let React state settle — see test_weekly_plan example in this iteration's Playwright script. Playwright's page.drag_and_drop native does NOT trigger React's dragstart handler reliably; use dispatchEvent with DataTransfer + await setTimeout between events.
